definitions.explanation: The foremost position in a line, group, or race; the front or leading position.

examples.japanese: {列|れつ}の{先頭|せんとう}に{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: I lined up at the front of the line.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{先頭|せんとう}を{走|はし}っている。
examples.english: He is running in the lead.

examples.japanese: {先頭|せんとう}{車両|しゃりょう}に{乗|の}った。
examples.english: I got on the front car (of the train).
examples.notes: 先頭車両 = front car/lead car

notes:
{先頭|せんとう} refers to being at the front or in the lead, whether physically in a line, in a race, or figuratively in leadership.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先頭|せんとう}に{立|た}つ: to stand at the front, to lead
- {先頭|せんとう}を{切|き}る: to take the lead, to be the first
- {先頭|せんとう}{集団|しゅうだん}: leading group (in a race)
- {先頭|せんとう}{車両|しゃりょう}: front car (of a train)
- {先頭|せんとう}{打者|だしゃ}: leadoff batter (baseball)

CONTRAST:
- {最後尾|さいこうび}: rear, end of line
- {後方|こうほう}: behind, in the rear
